title: <START> escaping note superseded by verbatim prompt leaves
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in prompt leaf content entirely: character card fields, persona, lorebook entries, memories, and scene text now reach the model verbatim (<thinking>, <scenario>, inline <div> pass through as written). This explicitly supersedes the #3623 framing ('<START> survives sanitization while other XML-looking text is escaped') that the Common Mistakes section still carries. Framework structural section wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers are unchanged.
fix: In Common Mistakes ('Writing examples in narrative...' bullet), replace the (v2.3) #3623 caveat with a (v2.3.4) note: all prompt leaf content is now verbatim — <START> and any other angle-bracket text in mes_example (and every card field) reaches the model exactly as written.

title: Verbatim prompt-leaf model not documented for card fields
reality: v2.3.4 finalized prompt leaf content as verbatim for Marinara's local single-user threat model: angle brackets in card fields, persona, lorebook entries, memories, and scene text are no longer escaped, which previously corrupted cards, broke roleplay HTML, and showed raw < in the editor. This also makes the file's own advice to put 'XML-tagged sections' in description/system_prompt actually work as written for card-authored fields.
fix: Add a (v2.3.4) note in 'Where Each Field Shows Up in the Prompt': card/persona/lorebook/memory/scene text is sent verbatim — authors can use XML tags and inline HTML in card fields deliberately; only macro-inserted values in agent XML contracts are still escaped.

title: Prompt section order now fixed to editor order (#3817)
reality: v2.3.4 (#3817) made Character and Persona prompt sections keep editor order across preset markers, fallbacks, agent lore, and Game/scene card contexts: Description, Personality, Backstory, Appearance, Scenario, then Example Dialogue when present. The file's field table says personality is 'Usually appended to description in the prompt preset', backstory 'sometimes — depends on preset configuration', mes_example 'Early in the prompt'.
fix: Update the 'Where Each Field Shows Up in the Prompt' table: state the (v2.3.4) canonical section order Description → Personality → Backstory → Appearance → Scenario → Example Dialogue; correct the mes_example row to note it renders last of the character sections.

title: PATCH deep-merge preserves extensions and embedded lorebook (#3858)
reality: v2.3.4 (#3858) deep-merges partial nested Character PATCH fields without materializing destructive defaults, so omitted extensions keys and embedded-lorebook data are preserved on partial updates.
fix: In the API Endpoints section (PATCH /:id) and/or the Mari field-safety paragraph, add a (v2.3.4) note: partial nested PATCHes deep-merge — omitted extensions fields and character_book data survive unrelated updates (#3858).

reality: v2.3.4 (#3859) validates and normalizes native Marinara character cards before persistence while preserving unknown embedded-lorebook properties.

title: {{group}} macro missing

fix: Add {{group}} to the macros coverage (Conversation macros subsection or the Group chat member recipe): (v2.3.4) {{group}} expands to every other active chat character, including during targeted/manual Roleplay group generation.

title: Per-character Hide From AI in Roleplay group chats missing
reality: v2.3.4 added per-character Hide From AI controls to Roleplay group chats: avatar-based multi-selection, recipient markers, and character-scoped prompt history, while preserving the existing global hide option.
fix: Add a (v2.3.4) bullet to the 'Group chat member' section: in Roleplay group chats, messages can be hidden from specific characters (avatar multi-select, recipient markers); each character then sees its own character-scoped prompt history, and the global Hide From AI option still exists.

title: Name Prefix History now Persona-accurate per turn
reality: v2.3.4 keeps each historical user turn under the Persona that sent it when Name Prefix History is enabled, instead of relabeling every user message with the currently selected Persona.
fix: Append a (v2.3.4) sentence to the Character vs. Persona section: with Name Prefix History enabled, historical user turns retain the Persona that actually sent them across persona switches.
